outputs.scope: Validate that a user can remove products from the cart from both the Inventory and Cart pages, and that the cart badge, entries, and available actions update immediately.
preconditions: At least one product exists in the shopping cart.
User is on the Inventory or Cart page.
outputs.approach: Cover the story with positive and negative UI scenarios that verify the cart is updated immediately when an item is removed and that no stale cart state remains after removal.

coverage.ui: Log in, add a product to the cart, navigate to the cart, remove the product, and verify the cart badge and cart contents update immediately.
traceability: Customers should be able to remove previously added products from their shopping cart.
The cart badge, cart contents, and product actions shall be updated accordingly.

coverage.ui: Remove a product from the Inventory page, confirm the cart badge count decrements and the cart item is no longer present when the cart is opened.
traceability: The application shall allow users to remove products from the cart from both the Inventory page and Cart page.
The cart badge, cart contents, and product actions shall be updated accordingly.

coverage.ui: Remove one item when multiple products are in the cart and verify that only the selected item is removed while the remaining product and badge count stay correct.
traceability: Customers should be able to remove previously added products from their shopping cart.
The cart badge and cart contents shall remain consistent after a partial removal.

next_recommendation: Generate manual test cases from this approved plan.
